lines: Yeh kaun aa gayi dilruba mehki mehki
couplets.en: Who is this lovely one who arrives in a cloud of scent?

lines: Fiza mehki mehki, hawa mehki mehki
couplets.en: The air is fragrant, and so is the breeze.

lines: Yeh kaun aa gayi dilruba mehki mehki
couplets.en: Who is this lovely one who arrives in a cloud of scent?

lines: Woh aankhon mein kajal, woh baalon mein gajra
couplets.en: Kohl rims her eyes, and flowers are woven into her hair.

lines: Hatheli pe uske hina mehki mehki
couplets.en: Henna leaves its scent in the palm of her hand.

lines: Yeh kaun aa gayi dilruba mehki mehki
couplets.en: Who is this lovely one who arrives in a cloud of scent?

lines: Khuda jaane kis kis ki yeh jaan legi
couplets.en: God knows how many hearts she will undo.

lines: Woh qatil ada, woh qaza mehki mehki
couplets.en: There is death in her grace, and even death is fragrant.
